laws.rule: Gayer Anderson Museum: Private photography is subject to the museum's ticket conditions. Commercial photography/video needs the competent authority's permission. No flash. Do not touch exhibits/showcases. Food and drinks are excluded from galleries except small water bottles. Bags/luggage larger than 40 by 40 cm are excluded from galleries and directed to the cloakroom. Follow posted instructions; this is the museum's visitor policy, not a governorate-wide photography or luggage rule.
